lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance white blobs posterior to the pectoral fin, organized into approximately five vertical columns with 4-5 spots per column visible in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming distinct grid-like nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges on the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-luminance dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges running toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 8-10 small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily within the anterior-basal region of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent semi-circular notch on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; secondary minor tissue irregularity on the distal trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae (remoras) visible beneath the left pectoral fin and along the ventral-lateral midline.
